🎬 RTX 视频升级器 — 单个和批量工作流程

两个 ComfyUI 工作流程使用 NVIDIA 的 RTX 视频超分辨率来升级您的视频。一个处理单个视频，另一个自动处理整个文件夹的视频 - 无需手动重新加载。

⚠️ 需要 NVIDIA RTX GPU。这不适用于 AMD、Intel 或非 RTX NVIDIA 卡。

包含内容：

  • 🎥 单一视频升级器— 加载一个视频，升级它，保存它。简单快捷。

  • 📁 批量视频放大器— 将其指向一个文件夹，对每个视频进行一次排队（或设置自动队列），然后它会自行处理整个文件夹。

所需的自定义节点（通过 ComfyUI Manager 安装、按名称搜索或使用下面的链接）：

  • Nvidia RTX 节点— 实际的升级者

  • ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite— 视频加载/保存

  • ComfyUI-BatchVideoLoader — 仅批处理工作流程需要— 让您指向一个文件夹，而不是一次选择一个文件

快速启动：

  1. 通过 ComfyUI Manager 安装以上节点

  2. 加载您需要的任何工作流程

  3. 对于第一个批次：设置文件夹路径，然后为每个视频对提示进行一次排队（或打开自动排队）

注意：如果您在批量保存视频时遇到错误，通常是以下两种情况之一：缩放后分辨率为奇数，或者 GPU 的视频编码器正忙于其他事情。两者都涵盖在GitHub 自述文件如果你遇到它。

🎬 RTX Video Upscaler — Single & Batch Workflows

Two ComfyUI workflows that use NVIDIA's RTX Video Super Resolution to upscale your videos. One does a single video, the other processes a whole folder of videos automatically — no manual re-loading needed.

⚠️ Requires an NVIDIA RTX GPU.This won't work on AMD, Intel, or non-RTX NVIDIA cards.

What's included:

  • 🎥 Single Video Upscaler— load one video, upscale it, save it. Simple and quick.

  • 📁 Batch Video Upscaler— point it at a folder, queue it once per video (or set Auto Queue), and it works through the whole folder on its own.

Required custom nodes(install via ComfyUI Manager, search by name, or use the links below):

  • Nvidia RTX Nodes— the actual upscaler

  • ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite— video loading/saving

  • ComfyUI-BatchVideoLoader — only needed for the batch workflow— lets you point at a folder instead of picking one file at a time

Quick start:

  1. Install the nodes above through ComfyUI Manager

  2. Load whichever workflow you need

  3. For the batch one: set the folder path, then queue the prompt once for each video (or turn on Auto Queue)

Heads up:if you hit an error saving a video partway through a batch, it's usually one of two things — an odd-numbered resolution after scaling, or your GPU's video encoder being busy with something else. Both are covered in theGitHub READMEif you run into it.
